sections.text: What do people in East London think Toynbee Hall could do to help make Tower Hamlets a happier and fairer place?
On 15th February, we are holding a community day.

The day is an opportunity for us to listen. What do people in East London think Toynbee Hall could do to help make Tower Hamlets a happier and fairer place? We also want to share the work we already do and welcome people to the new space.
As part of preparations, we’d like to hear from you. Can you help us plan to make this a great event?
Join us for a planning meeting on Friday 24th January 2020, 12:00-13:00
If you would prefer to share your thoughts about planning the Community Day in another way, please email Bethan Mobey or call 07983462374.
